name: Hatch Row
description: Three soups in a near-split kitchen: prep on the left, cooking on the right, and a wall between them with three hatches and a single gap at its end. Built for the pass-through shelf; with the switch off the hatches are wall.
strategy: One chef chops on the left and posts through the hatches; the other cooks, plates and serves on the right and posts the empty plates back. The gap at the end of the wall is for whoever gets stuck.
